description: CGS Alquist Priolo Fault Zones is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by California Department of Conservation. This data set contains the Alquist-Priolo Earthquake Fault Zones as shown on the Official Alquist-Priolo Earthquake Fault Zones Maps. The dataset is comprised of polygons that form regulatory zone boundaries (Alquist-Priolo Earthquake Fault Zones). Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher California Department of Conservation. Its tags are Alquist-Priolo, CGS, CNRA, California, California Department of Conservation. It offers 11 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GDB, GEOJSON, GPKG. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
